rule.description: A method on a nameable struct receiver that performs at least three field accesses spanning at least three distinct fields of one other named struct type, and touches that foreign type's fields more often than it touches its own receiver's fields.

checks.description: Detect methods that decide which pattern of a digit record to emit by reading that record's fields, while their own state contributes almost nothing.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The variant-selection rule is stated entirely in terms of the digit record's own data (odd, even and right-hand patterns), with the helper contributing only a parity sequence copied out of the same record family; the behavior belongs with the record whose patterns it picks.

matches.evidence: barsAt branches across num.LeftEven, num.LeftOdd and num.Right for every content position while consulting dp.parity, a slice copied from encodedNumber.CheckSum by newDigitPlan during encodeEAN13.

checks.description: Detect owner-less helper methods that re-derive symbol geometry and payload capacity from the raw fields of a layout description record.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The planner type defines no data of its own and exists only to route two already-established facts of the version layout tables (matrix width and data-region capacity) through raw fields; the descriptive behavior belongs with the tables that own the data.

matches.evidence: frameMetrics reads vi.Version, vi.NumberOfBlocksInGroup1, vi.DataCodeWordsPerBlockInGroup1, vi.NumberOfBlocksInGroup2 and vi.DataCodeWordsPerBlockInGroup2 directly to rebuild the module width and the data byte capacity consumed by render and addPaddingAndTerminator in qr/encoder.go.

checks.description: Detect methods that re-open a symbol description record and re-derive its budget arithmetic from raw fields instead of consulting the record's own accessors.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The ECC pass re-derives the size profile's region geometry, block data budgets and ECC budgets inline, duplicating accounting rules the profile already states about itself, including its uneven 144x144 special case.

matches.evidence: calcECC reads size.Rows, size.Columns, size.RegionCountHorizontal, size.RegionCountVertical, size.ECCCount and size.BlockCount directly, inlining the per-block data budget (with the 156/155 split for the 144x144 size) and the per-block ECC budget that the profile already exposes through its accessors.

excluded.reason: The receiver is a slice type, not an owner of named struct data; the interleaving loop legitimately consumes the version info it is handed and stays below the distinct-field boundary.
The method works through its own single configuration field toward the shared Galois field machinery; this is genuine collaboration, not behavior that belongs on another owner.
Two-field owners cooperate here; the relation cannot span three distinct foreign fields and the arithmetic already lives with its coefficients.
High-level encoding is driven by free functions over a mode state; there is no competing method-on-struct owner whose data the functions re-state.

The geometry math is duplicated in spirit but its holder is not consulted by a method that re-derives it from raw fields; it repeats an already-covered size-planning role rather than carrying the relation.
Each helper stays within one or two fields of a single table record, below the three-distinct-field boundary; adding them would repeat the EAN digit-record relation.
